steps.en: The failed payment is saved as failed
steps.why_en: A late failure report can overwrite a payment that already succeeded.
steps.why_id: Laporan gagal yang telat dapat menimpa pembayaran yang sudah berhasil.

steps.en: Unsuccessful payments are sent to the failure page
steps.id: Pembayaran tidak berhasil diarahkan ke halaman gagal
steps.why_en: Unknown or unreadable results also land on the failure page.
steps.why_id: Hasil tidak jelas atau gagal dibaca juga berakhir di halaman gagal.

steps.en: An error message tells the offender the payment failed
steps.id: Pesan error memberi tahu offender bahwa pembayaran gagal

steps.en: The offender is returned to the payment mode choices
steps.id: Offender dikembalikan ke pilihan mode pembayaran
steps.why_en: The only button goes back to the start of fine search, not to the list of payment modes.
steps.why_id: Satu-satunya tombol kembali ke awal pencarian denda, bukan ke daftar mode pembayaran.

steps.en: The offender can try paying again with any mode
steps.id: Offender dapat mencoba bayar lagi dengan mode apa pun
steps.why_en: A retry right after a failure is blocked for up to five minutes.
steps.why_id: Mencoba bayar lagi tepat setelah gagal diblokir hingga lima menit.
